programme.desc: A small-town girl overcomes all societal barriers to become a national-level athlete, but her glory is meaningless when she must undergo a gender test.

programme.desc: Vanshika, a simple girl, is hired by a rich man to take care of his bratty, wayward son.

programme.title: Kakuda

programme.desc: Ram, a union leader, falls in love with the factory's new owner, Sita. However, management disputes create complications in their relationship.

programme.title: Kasam Suhaag Ki
programme.desc: Troubles arise for Surajmukhi after her husband, Sultan, is gunned down and she and her daughter get abducted by goons. She tries her best to get revenge and escape with her child.

programme.title: Karma
programme.desc: Accompanied by a troubled trio of prisoners, a high-ranking law enforcement officer sets out to avenge the miseries inflicted upon his family by an anti-national group.

programme.title: Jodidar
programme.desc: Ganesh, an elephant, watches his master being killed by three poachers. After many years, Ganesh can identify the killers while being in the service of a new master, Munna.

programme.title: Fukrey Returns
programme.desc: Bholi Punjaban is back with a vengeance for round two of mischief, mayhem, and a get-rich-quick extravaganza with Hunny, Zafar, Lali, and deja choo expert Choocha.

programme.title: Sher Ka Shikaar
programme.desc: A man, who is famous in his village for killing man-eating tigers, unwillingly becomes a part of a conspiracy surrounding illegal drugs.

programme.title: Paying Guests
programme.desc: Four unemployed friends are unable to find a place to stay because they are not married.

programme.title: Maaligai
programme.desc: A female police officer goes to an ancient palace to investigate. However, once she enters the palace, she gets a vision of her past life where she was a fierce and beautiful princess.

programme.title: Radhe: Your Most Wanted Bhai
programme.desc: Radhe, a daredevil encounter specialist of the Mumbai Police force, vows to knock down the crime syndicate led by an evil drug lord.

programme.title: Bhimaa
programme.desc: After some mysterious instances at a temple of historical significance, a detective visits the region to investigate and find out the truth behind the incidents.

programme.title: Vivah
programme.desc: Poonam, a traditional young woman, gets engaged to Prem, a wealthy man. Their faith and love are tested when an accident occurs and leaves Poonam with first degree burns.

programme.title: Sheelavathi - The Ghaati Queen
programme.desc: A resilient woman enters the high-stakes cannabis trade out of sheer desperation. However, her choice quickly leads her down a dangerous and life-threatening path.

programme.title: Akhanda 2
programme.desc: Renowned warrior Akhanda resurfaces to confront a dangerous tantric practitioner sowing chaos. However, he is not alone in his quest for peace as his twin brother Murali Krishna joins the fight.

programme.title: Kaliveera
programme.desc: Kaliveera follows Kali, a young tribal man who takes a stand against powerful criminals. Meanwhile, he hazards everything to dismantle a dangerous international syndicate.

programme.title: Cirkus
programme.desc: Two sets of identical twins are separated at birth and grow in two different cities. Years later, chaos ensues when one set of twins decides to visit the town where the other runs a circus.

programme.title: Sye Raa Narasimha Reddy
programme.desc: Uyyalawada Narasimha Reddy, the ruler of the Rayalaseema region, resists the tyranny of the East India Company and sparks a revolution in the process.
